home.heading: Hi, I'm Erdan!

Most recently, I worked as a Product Manager Intern at Rae Health, where I defined the company's first North Star metric and supporting metric tree for a live clinical wearable platform.
previousWork: Before graduate school, I spent nearly four years as a Senior IT Project Manager at Attract Group, where I owned the discovery to launch process for 10+ client products across fintech, marketplace, and healthtech, managing cross functional teams of up to 15 engineers and specialists.

On the side, I've been building the PM Thinking Coach. It is a learning app with a structured PM skill tree, 159 lessons, 36 simulation scenarios, and a 515-term glossary, built on SwiftUI and FastAPI.

items.title: PM Thinking Coach
items.summary: A learning app that turns the product management skill map into a route: structured lessons, then a real situation with incomplete data that checks you can apply the skill.
items.imageAlt: PM Thinking Coach: the Map screen showing the skill tree of six domains across three rings
items.tagline: Turning the PM skill map into a route you can walk

sections.heading: What it is
paragraphs: A learning app built from problem statement to a working end to end product: a PM skill tree of structured learning blocks and interactive decision scenarios to learn and evaluate your seniority level, on a SwiftUI client with a FastAPI + Postgres backend.

sections.heading: How it works
paragraphs: The design problem was to build something that measures thinking rather than recall. Scoring rewards reasoning over answer-picking, and a content validator enforces it.
bullets: Rationale and communication carry 60 of 100 points against 25 for the decision itself, so picking the right option cannot pass on its own
Covered 7 competency tracks across three proficiency levels: product sense, analytics, user research, prioritization, execution, communication, and system design
Total of 159 lessons, 36 simulation scenarios, and a 515-term glossary
Implemented an audio overview feature that narrates lessons and coaching feedback for hands-free review

sections.heading: Measuring it
paragraphs: Defined the beta success metrics before launch: activation, time to first value, D7 repeat practice, and feedback usefulness.
